run_simulation_main: run a TORAX transport simulation using simulation_app.main with a config getter and optional logging flags
write_output_to_file: write simulation xarray DataTree output to a NetCDF file at a given path
log_simulation_output_to_stdout: log the initial and final simulation core profile states to stdout
log_to_stdout: log a message to stdout with optional ANSI color formatting
build_simulation_entrypoint: build a runnable simulation entrypoint by passing a config builder callable to simulation_app.main
